description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md from /workspace/skills/flash-thoughts/ to discover the exact workflow. 2. The agent must invoke `python3 scripts/flash.py add '<thought>'` three times from within the skill directory (or with the correct path to scripts/flash.py), adding each of the three research ideas. 3. Each invocation must produce an entry in ~/notes/flash/YYYY-MM-DD.md with: (a) a top-level header '# YYYY-MM-DD 闪念', (b) '---' separator lines between entries, and (c) time-headed sub-headers of the form '## HH:MM - <content>'. 4. The agent must then run `python3 scripts/flash.py search 'genomics'` to retrieve the matching entry. 5. The proprietary trap: the file must be stored in ~/notes/flash/ (not in the workspace), must contain the Chinese suffix '闪念' in the header, and must use the exact '---' separator and '## HH:MM -' entry format — all of which only appear in the SKILL.md documentation.
